Adolion: The Saga
Author view
Overview
Memory
⚑
Where you are
The Night After the Trial
At the dueling ground.
Things are close to breaking.
About this story
The whole of Adolion, played as one long campaign. You start as a new adventuring party at the Guild in Aegis City, with Belle and Dalan beside you, and every posting you take, every house you serve and every friend you make is carried forward into the next. The roads out of Aegis City are yours to choose, and the choices add up. Make your persona the heir of House Nightriver who has chosen the adventurer's life, with a spark of seal-born magic.
Recently
You left Trial by Combat behind and moved into The Night After the Trial.
Ronan stepped forward from the Nightriver retinue, poised and watchful as he checked on Max Nightriver and eyed General Leevon. King Alexander ordered the shattered lance yielded for the Church's examination, declaring the trial void if poison was confirmed. The tension held as royal guards moved to secure the weapon.
Open threads
Whether General Leevon faces punishment for envenoming his weapon in a Trial by Combat.
Who opened the servants' door that should have been barred for the night, and what that intrusion portends.
The story so far
Max Nightriver confronted his sister Natalia about their father Javon's arranged betrothal and learned the seals binding the Witch King, the Lich Queen's servant, depended on Nightriver blood. Natalia told him that she, Max, and Welden each carried part of the lock in their veins: if the line ended the Witch King would wake, and if the blood thinned he would stir. She revealed that Javon's marriage arrangements were not alliances but ways of securing the lock, and that Kippon Bertoanal was meant to be the next link in the chain.
Following along.
Waiting for the next reply.

Short-term (1)
Max Nightriver entered Natalia's rooms and demanded to know what Lord Javon and Duchess Eriana meant by "the seals." Natalia sealed the door with frost and offered a bargain: she would explain the seals if Max revealed the contents of the Crown-sealed parchment. Max agreed and disclosed that the parchment was General Leevon's claim to Trial by Combat, which Javon wanted him to fight; Natalia then revealed that the seals bind the Witch King, a servant of the Lich Queen, and that Nightriver blood sustains the lock, making her betrothal to Kippon Bertoanal a means of securing it. Max returned to Javon's study and accepted the role of the Crown's second against General Leevon, then overheard servants and Shiya in the corridor predicting his death; when he confronted Shiya, she called him a fool but implied she would keep him alive. After three days of drills, Max entered the lists before King Alexander and the court to face General Leevon, and before the first pass he raised his hand to show the court venom on the General's lance. Merryn, the High Saintess, rose from the royal gallery and demanded the Herald halt the trial so the weapon could be examined, while General Leevon's grip tightened on his dragon-bone lance.
